limitations: Configured maxima are best-effort targets with burst allowance, not exact per-second ceilings.
No inference about AWS private allocation, partition credits, refill, deterministic throttle ordinals or instantaneous control convergence.
Sequence numbers are invocation order. Concurrent completion order is retained by timestamps.
Projected reads charge the whole stored image. Failed verification reads leave mutation state unknown.
Absent metric data is unpublished/unknown, never a fabricated zero; gauges aggregate over five minutes.
Only owned synthetic data is used. Data requests are not retried; distinct pressure attempts are labeled.

reproductionNotes: Primary capture ran the probe before two-second control pacing was added; two partial table controls encountered native account control-plane throttling. Their exact errors are retained.

A paced supplemental table captured both partial merges and a second empty-map InternalFailure. A second supplemental indexed table captured the >40000 bounds, mixed maxima and indexed billing transitions. These steps are retained in the consolidated reusable script, which reuses its existing tables instead of creating supplemental tables.
The final post-cleanup metric snapshot was taken separately after publication delay. The reusable script now includes a bounded post-cleanup metric wait.
The consolidated script was syntax-checked; the underlying native requests retained here were actually executed. No claim of deterministic pressure ordinals or identical timing is made.

The focused composite addendum executed the exact composite_pressure and verify_composite_effects helpers now retained in the probe. Only the missing composite scenarios and pressure setup were run, using two additional owned tables, both verified absent.

The indexCreationAddendum was executed separately with the same signed request helper and an STS account guard. Both GSI creation forms rejected a -1 read maximum alongside a positive write maximum. The consolidated probe now includes these exact negative request shapes before data pressure.

uncertainty: Focused composite addendum established GSI-write maximum ThrottlingException for both transaction APIs and per-statement ThrottlingError for BatchExecuteStatement; table-max-specific transaction/statement mapping remains unobserved.
BatchWriteItem configured-maximum exception/partial-write boundary and BatchExecuteStatement SELECT configured-read-maximum error boundary remain unobserved.
Mixed table/GSI maxima produced only table write maximum reasons; simultaneous dual-reason behavior was not established.
No GSI maximum gauge or -1/absent-limit gauge sample was published; empty series remain unknown, not zero.
No integer type/fractional/string validation, raised account quota, global-table or cross-region behavior was exercised.
Native empty table maximum InternalFailure is an observation, not a recommended emulator failure contract.
